note: This file is a pure MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, scalars). It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It is used by the MMSegmentation training framework to configure the Sapiens 1B normal estimation model for the Render People dataset at 1024x768 resolution.
summary: Configuration for training a Sapiens 1B VisionTransformer-based normal estimation model on synthetic Render People data. Key settings: AdamW optimizer with layer decay (rate=0.85), 200 epochs, PolyLR scheduler, CosineSimilarityLoss + L1Loss, batch_size=1, image_size=768x1024, pretrained checkpoint from sapiens_1b_epoch_173_clean.pth.
